newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Miami-bound flight aborts Brazil take off.
newsitem.headline: Miami-bound flight aborts Brazil take off.

text.p: An engine exploded under the wing of a United Airlines plane taking off from Rio de Janeiro on a flight to Miami but all the passengers got off the plane safely with no one injured, a newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The Boeing 767 aircraft was about to take off Monday night from Rio de Janeiro's international airport when the engine under the left wing exploded, O Globo newspaper said.
The pilot broke off flight 990 and the aircraft remained on the runway for an hour before the passengers were taken off the plane.
No one was hurt and all the passengers were rescheduled on other flights the same night or the next day, O Globo said.

Passengers claimed to have seen flames coming from the left engine, but United Airlines officials denied the engine had caught fire, saying the flight was aborted because the engine overheated, O Globo said.
There was no one available at United Airlines Wednesday to confirm the events.
